en.topic_title: Subdivided flat residents swelter in heat that feels like 52°C, climate NGO finds
en.topic_summary:
Residents living in “shoebox” flats and other inadequate housing have experienced temperatures that feel like 52 degrees Celsius this summer, a climate NGO has found.



A tenant in a “coffin home.” Photo: James Lee/HKFP.



The CarbonCare InnoLab said in a press conference on Sunday that it took temperature and humidity readings at 86 households over the past two months, 80 per cent of which were classified as inadequate housing, such as subdivided flats and “coffin home
